title: When Are Images Needed in Multimodal Machine Translation? Text-Only Routing for On-Demand Visual Context
abstract: arXiv:2611.27712v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Image-guided multimodal machine translation (MMT) leverages visual context to resolve translation-relevant uncertainty. However, prevailing systems either process images unconditionally or apply gating only after visual encoding, leaving redundant visual computation unavoidable. To mitigate this computational overhead, routing decisions must rely on a pre-visual source signal. Crucially, surface-level ambiguity does not equate to visual dependence, as intra-sentence textual context often suffices for disambiguation. We therefore formulate visual invocation as source-text sufficiency prediction: determining exclusively from the source text whether translation-relevant uncertainty remains unresolved. To support this formulation, we construct a visual-dependency dataset with three fine-grained labels (no_ambiguity, text_resolved, and vision_needed) and verify discriminative visual evidence for vision_needed instances. translated_title: 多模态机器翻译何时需要图像？基于纯文本路由的按需视觉上下文
translated_abstract: 图像引导的多模态机器翻译（MMT）利用视觉上下文来消解与翻译相关的不确定性。然而，现有主流系统要么无条件地处理图像，要么仅在视觉编码之后才应用门控机制，使得冗余的视觉计算不可避免。为了缓解这一计算开销，路由决策必须依赖于视觉编码之前的源端信号。至关重要的是，表层的歧义并不等同于视觉依赖性，因为句内文本上下文通常足以完成消歧。因此，我们将视觉调用形式化为源文本充分性预测：仅根据源文本来判断与翻译相关的不确定性是否仍未得到解决。为支持这一形式化，我们构建了一个包含三个细粒度标签（no_ambiguity、text_resolved 和 vision_needed）的视觉依赖数据集，并为 vision_needed 实例验证了具有区分性的视觉证据。我们进一步提出了 Pre……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将多模态机器翻译中的图像调用形式化为“源文本充分性预测”任务，构建了含三个细粒度标签的视觉依赖数据集，实现仅凭源文本即可按需判断是否需要视觉上下文的路由方法，从而避免冗余的视觉计算开销。
